in_marathi.name: Mukthi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mukthi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mukthi is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Mukta', which means 'liberated' or 'redeemed'. It is a name given to a child believed to be born free from worldly desires and attachments. In Hindu mythology, Mukthi is also the name of the goddess of liberation who grants moksha or salvation to souls.
